sodaAsh.fact: Chinese soda ash inventories at an all-time high of 1.73 mt; producers running at high utilisation; export prices US$160-180/t FOB, US$170-190 CIF South-East Asia; most Chinese producers losing money on a cash basis; management sees ~US$170 as the floor.
Supply cuts so far: a ~800 kt Chinese plant stopped when its production permit lapsed; one US producer with 1.36 mt capacity mothballed; Solvay cut ~180 kt in Spain.

TCNA completed the purchase of Searles Valley Minerals' soda ash customer contracts (more than 0.5 mt over two years) as the winning bidder in Searles Valley's Chapter 11 process, on 11-Sep-2026. Price not disclosed.

Demand: India strongest market; China and US flat (US container glass weak); LATAM up on lithium carbonate (exports to Argentina +53%, Chile +32%); SE Asia marginally down. Lithium carbonate needs ~2 t soda ash per t; Indian solar glass could add 7,500-10,000 t a month of dense ash demand.

Middle East conflict lifted energy, raw material and freight costs for synthetic producers in Europe, Turkiye and India (coal, limestone, HFO); natural (trona) producers in the US are less exposed except logistics.

India: soda ash imports rose 89% from 517,653 t (FY23) to 979,996 t (FY24); a minimum import price of Rs20,108/t applied from Dec-2024 and was extended to 31-Dec-2025; DGTR opened a safeguard (quantity restriction) investigation on 16-Mar-2026.
Tata Chemicals' Indian market share FY25: 14% soda ash, 32% sodium bicarbonate.

tataSons.fact: RBI rejected Tata Sons' application (filed 28-Mar-2024) to surrender its NBFC/CIC registration on 11-Sep-2026, so Tata Sons must follow upper-layer NBFC rules, which include listing. Tata Chemicals rose 20% to Rs735 on 15-Sep-2026.

Tata Trusts (66% of Tata Sons) proposed merging Tata Electronics Systems Solutions and Tata Consulting Engineers into Tata Sons so that it no longer qualifies as an NBFC/CIC, which could avoid a listing; Tata Chemicals fell 4.9% to Rs610 on the report.

Tata Chemicals owns 10,237 Tata Sons shares (2.53%), carried at Rs57 cr. Press estimates of the stake's value range from ~Rs10,000-15,000 cr to ~Rs20,000-25,000 cr depending on the assumed Tata Sons valuation (Rs9-12.5 lakh cr in an IPO per one estimate).
Earlier spike: the stock rose 36% in six sessions to a record in Mar-2024 on Tata Sons listing speculation (weekly close peak Rs1,315 on 7-Mar-2024).

moat: Green River trona is among the lowest-cost soda ash in the world; Magadi is natural too. But the US unit earned US$1/t EBITDA in Q1FY27 because exports are priced off Chinese synthetic ash.
Mithapur is integrated (salt, limestone, power); 14% soda ash and 32% bicarb share; import parity pricing lifts it when the rupee weakens.
China (record inventory, cash-negative producers) sets the export price; realisations follow the cycle.
Food/pharma grades need customer approval and are stickier; >90% share in Indian scFOS; but technical bicarb faces new Indian capacity.
AA+ ratings; net debt Rs5,961 cr (Mar-26) is ~4x FY26 EBITDA ex-Rallis, high for a cyclical.
